title: Arvin Road, Crossing Without a Crosswalk, Horizontal IDs on Route 12, & Yearly Passes at Fairlawn
description: Settling into the brick ranch on Arvin Road as unofficial homeowners, Katie and Nate sleep skin to skin in their bedroom closet while leaving the queen bed untouched, brave the crosswalk-free traffic of Indian River Road and Military Highway for groceries at Market Square, ride CVTA Route 12 to the Buckner Boulevard DMV to trade their 2001 vertical Under-21 IDs for horizontal 21+ State IDs printed on the spot, and take CVTA Routes 15 and 25 to get yearly memberships at the 1977 Fairlawn Recreation Center.
